rules.requirement: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.

assertingTests.name: Investigator learns one of two players is a particular Minion (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01)
the Washerwoman, Librarian and Investigator steps are built on the first night only with the one-of-two shape (TB-WASHERWOMAN-01, TB-LIBRARIAN-01, TB-INVESTIGATOR-01, SYS-NIGHT-02)
a one-of-two step without a prepared answer asks for setup and changes nothing (TB-WASHERWOMAN-01, TB-LIBRARIAN-01, TB-INVESTIGATOR-01)
the Investigator module declares a step for the first night only, with the one-of-two shape (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01)
the Investigator shows the answer prepared in setup and names every Minion as possible (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
the Investigator reads no fact, so its decision is the same whether or not its owner is drunk or poisoned (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
a journal recorded before the zero became the Librarian's alone replays and undoes as written (TB-WASHERWOMAN-01, TB-INVESTIGATOR-01)
the Investigator declares no zero, so an Investigator always learns a character (TB-INVESTIGATOR-01)
